        ∀ (t : Nat), LT.lt.{0} t T → LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace.mulError E i b t)) u)
    (And
      (∀ (i : Fin m) (b : Nat),
        LT.lt.{0} b (BlockMatrixVector.blockCount n T) →
          ∀ (t : Nat),
            LE.le.{0} 1 t →
              LT.lt.{0} t T → LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace.blockAddError E i b t)) u)
      (∀ (i : Fin m) (b : Nat),
        LE.le.{0} 1 b →
          LT.lt.{0} b (BlockMatrixVector.blockCount n T) →
            LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace.outerAddError E i b)) u))

declarations.type:
∀ {m n T : Nat} (A : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin m) (Fin n) Real) (x : Fin n → Real) (u : Real)
  (E : BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace m),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    LE.le.{0} 0 u →
      BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace.Valid E n T u →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T)) u) 1 →
          ∃ ΔA,
            And (Eq.{1} (BlockMatrixVector.computed A x T E) (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A ΔA) x))
              (∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n),
                LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔA i j))
                  (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (BlockMatrixVector.gamma (BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T) u)
                    (abs.{0} (A i j))))

declarations.name: BlockMatrixVector.block_matrix_vector_product_constructed
declarations.type:
∀ {m n T : Nat} (A : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin m) (Fin n) Real) (x : Fin n → Real) (u : Real)
  (E : BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace m),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    LE.le.{0} 0 u →
      BlockMatrixVector.RoundingTrace.Valid E n T u →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T)) u) 1 →
          And
            (Eq.{1} (BlockMatrixVector.computed A x T E)
              (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} A (BlockMatrixVector.perturbation A T E)) x))
            (∀ (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n),
              LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (BlockMatrixVector.perturbation A T E i j))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (BlockMatrixVector.gamma (BlockMatrixVector.errorCount n T) u) (abs.{0} (A i j))))
